_comment: RC-041 gap 3C/3D - the SHARED grading list for inject-text sanitization.
Two implementations must agree on it: sanitize_inject_text +
sanitize_wake_text (scripts/rally_wake.py). The Rust list is canonical; the
Python one mirrors it because rally_wake.py writes to a tmux pane the rally
binary cannot address, so it cannot route through the CLI chokepoint.
Every codepoint under test is written as a \u escape ON PURPOSE: a literal
invisible character here would be unreviewable, which is exactly the
property that makes it hostile in a pane.
NUL is absent on purpose - it cannot cross argv, so the CLI leg could not
carry it; backends.rs covers NUL in a unit test.

cases.name: u2028_line_separator
cases.why: Zl, not Cc - the ARP-004 forged-line class survived char::is_control

cases.name: u2029_paragraph_separator
cases.why: Zp, same class as U+2028

cases.name: rlo_bidi_override
cases.why: U+202E reverses displayed order - the pane can read backwards from the bytes

cases.name: lrm_rlm_marks
cases.why: zero-width directional marks

cases.name: bidi_isolates
cases.why: U+2066-U+2069 isolate and reorder a span

cases.name: zwsp_hides_a_word_boundary
cases.why: ZWSP splits a token the reader sees as whole

cases.name: bom_leading
cases.why: U+FEFF is zero-width and makes the first token unmatchable

cases.name: soft_hyphen
cases.why: U+00AD is invisible in most renderers

cases.name: tag_characters
cases.why: the TAG block mirrors ASCII invisibly - the prompt-smuggling carrier

cases.name: private_use
cases.why: Co renders per-font with no interoperable meaning

cases.name: noncharacter_fffe
cases.why: permanent noncharacter (Cn)

cases.name: arabic_letter_mark
cases.why: Cf, and directional like the bidi marks

cases.name: word_joiner
cases.why: zero-width joiner-class format control

cases.name: mongolian_vowel_separator
cases.why: zero-width in modern Unicode, historically a space

cases.name: esc_paste_end_marker
cases.why: the paste-breakout guard - ESC dropped, so the frame cannot close early

cases.name: newline_and_cr
cases.why: this path appends its own submit CR; a body newline could submit a partial line

cases.name: del_and_c1
cases.why: DEL and the C1 block are Cc

cases.name: keeps_tab
cases.why: tab is the one Cc character the channel keeps - real content in pasted text

cases.name: keeps_spaces_and_punctuation
cases.why: ordinary prose must survive intact

cases.name: keeps_non_latin_scripts
cases.why: CJK, accents, symbols and Arabic letters are content, not controls

cases.name: keeps_variation_selector_supplement
cases.why: U+E0100 is Mn, not C - a real Ideographic Variation Sequence, kept on purpose

cases.name: keeps_combining_marks
cases.why: combining acute is Mn - decomposed text must survive
